'''50''' ('''fifty''') is the [[natural number]] following [[49 (number)|49]] and preceding [[51 (number)|51]].

==In mathematics==
[[File:square-sum-50.png|thumb|50 as the sum of two non-zero squares]]
Fifty is the smallest number that is the sum of two non-zero [[square numbers]] in two distinct ways.<ref>de Koninck, J.M. (2009). ''Those fascinating numbers''. AMS Bookstore. p. 18. {{ISBN|0-8218-4807-0}}.</ref> 50 is an unsigned [[Stirling number of the first kind]]<ref>{{Cite OEIS|sequencenumber=A000254|name=Unsigned Stirling numbers of first kind, s(n+1,2): a(n+1) = (n+1)*a(n) + n!.}}</ref> and a [[Narayana number]].<ref>{{Cite OEIS|sequencenumber=A001263|name=Triangle of Narayana numbers T(n,k) = C(n-1,k-1)*C(n,k-1)/k with 1 <= k <= n, read by rows. Also called the Catalan triangle.}}</ref>

{{Wiktionary|fifty}}

==In science==
Fifty is the fifth [[magic number (physics)|magic number]] in nuclear physics, corresponding to the element [[tin]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Magic number |url=https://www.britannica.com/science/magic-number-atomic-structure |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20230810012806/https://www.britannica.com/science/magic-number-atomic-structure |archive-date=10 August 2023 |access-date=22 November 2025 |website=Encyclopedia Britannica}}</ref>

==In religion==
In Hindu [[Tantra|tantric tradition]], the number 50 holds significance as the 50 [[Rudras]] in the [[Kashmir Shaivism|Malinīvijayottara]] correlate with the 50 [[phoneme]]s of [[Sanskrit]], as well as with the 50 severed heads worn around goddess [[Kali|Kali']]s head. The [[mantra]] ''Aham'' ("I am"), as laid out in the [[Vijñāna Bhairava Tantra|Vijñāna Bhairava]] represents the first अ(a) and last ह(ha) phonemes of the Sanskrit alphabet and is believed to represent [[ultimate reality]], in accordance with its [[Nonduality (spirituality)|non-dual]] philosophy.{{Relevance|reason=This needs a reliable source and to be rewritten. The 32 Paths example in [[WP:NUM/G]] is directly on point here.|date=November 2025}}

==In other fields==
The [[percentage]] (50%) equivalent to one half, so that the phrase "fifty-fifty" commonly expresses something divided equally in two; in business this is often denoted as being the ultimate in equal partnership

Fifty years of marriage is marked by the gold or "golden" [[wedding anniversary]].

50 is the number of states the [[United States]] contains.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Ganeri |first=Anita |url=https://www.google.com/books/edition/United_States_of_America/p89-DwAAQBAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=the+united+states+has+50+states&pg=PA30&printsec=frontcover |title=United States of America: A Benjamin Blog and His Inquisitive Dog Guide |date=2019 |publisher=Capstone |isbn=978-1-4109-7036-7 |pages=30 |language=en}}</ref>
